paredes: Giant stone walls sliding and grinding, deep rumble, heavy slam shut at the end
robos: Menacing mechanical creatures skittering on metal legs, servo whirs and clanks approaching fast

musica: Instrumental cinematic sci-fi thriller score: mysterious pulsing synths and low drones at the start, tension building with ticking percussion, a fast chase section with driving drums around 40 seconds, a dark revelation, then a bright uplifting orchestral finale of freedom in the last 15 seconds. No vocals.
